about: The ministers pray for the priest in the singular: “misereátur tui”, “peccátis tuis”, “perdúcat te”, and the priest answers “Amen”. After the ministers' confession the same formula appears in the plural. Only then does the priest add the “Indulgéntiam” prayer.

seg.tr: May almighty God have mercy on you and, having forgiven your sins, bring you to eternal life.

seg.nr: The priest straightens up. The ministers now repeat the confession — in the same words, with the single change the missal states outright: where the priest said “to you, brethren” and “you, brethren”, they say “to you, father” and “you, father”.
